extraction.Name: Philip Conoyer (deceased); Sarah Douville (heir/deponent)
extraction.Refused/Protested: Not to the best of my knowledge
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband and son farms and I do what I can
extraction.NOTES: Philip Conoyer is deceased; he received the patent in 1920 and died the same year. Sarah Douville is his mother and heir. She sold the land for $6000.00 cash. She is keeping a grandchild whose mother is dead. Sarah Douville states her health is 'Not so good this year.' Notarized before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, May 2, 1929; commission expires 4-28-32.
